intro.text: Hi everyone. Today we are going to build a screen flow that creates a case.

search.text: First, open Setup, and search for flows in the Quick Find box.

click1.text: Now, on the New Flow button, click here.

click2.text: Then select Screen Flow, and to create it, click here.

drag.text: Drag a screen element onto the canvas, and give it a label.

click3.text: Finally, to save the flow, click here.
